description: Where a class, method or function is declared in the code of the repositories connected to a project: its file, line and signature. Ask by name, or Class.Method to say whose. Only repositories whose owners opened them to agents are asked.

name.description: The symbol's name, e.g. 'MoveAsync', or 'IssueTransition.MoveAsync' to say whose.

path.description: Keep only declarations in files whose path contains this.

repo.description: Which repository, as 'group/repo'. Omit to ask every repository open here.

name: code_symbols
